- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/02/14 (Tue) 09:23
- [USER] User asked how to change the default blogger comment avatar.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To change the default commenter avatar in Blogger, you will need to follow these steps:
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 1: Sign in to your Blogger account.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 2: Go to the "Settings" tab of the blog you wish to edit.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 3: Select the "Comments" option.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 4: Scroll down to the "Comment Form Avatar" section.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 5: Click the "Change" button to upload a new image or select one from the existing images on your blog.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 6: Save your changes by clicking the "Save Changes" button at the top of the page.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Please note that this process may vary depending on the template and version of Blogger you are using.
